proposals.evidence: DEDR 4517 full article (p. 399) gives 4517 Ta. pottu (potti-) to light (as a fire). Kurub. (LSB 1.12) potte a torch of leaves. Ko. pot- (poty-) to light (as a fire); pot torch made of a bundle of thin sticks. Ka. pottu to be kin Bhat pottu “to burn” matches Lindgren Koraga pottu “burning” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
